messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Multi-group sem models
parts:
Is there another way to move towards partial invariance as the partialInvariance function returns
round(partialInvariance(models1, type = "scalar", p.adjust = "holm"),3)
Error in round(partialInvariance(models1, type = "scalar", p.adjust = "holm"),  : 
  non-numeric argument to mathematical function

The partialInvariance() function doesn't cause that error.  As the message says, the error is caused by submitting a non-numeric object (the data.frame returned by partialInvariance) to round().  Just run partialInvariance(models1, type = "scalar", p.adjust = "holm")

Terrence D. Jorgensen
Assistant Professor, Methods and Statistics
Research Institute for Child Development and Education, the University of Amsterdam
